purpose: Public summary of actual FPS/network measurement blockers; not a performance pass or a measured performance failure

presentMon.target: Running Minecraft.Windows process selected by its current PID; identifier omitted from public summary
presentMon.helpPrefixCheck: -help and --help returned identical 4326-byte help text; installed help documents --process_id and --output_file
presentMon.prefixConclusion: Single/double hyphen choice did not change the observed failure
presentMon.caution: ETW privilege and stopped service findings do not prove the direct cause of the silent PresentMon exit

pktmon.result: Access denied communicating with PktMon driver

toolDiscovery.scope: Targeted command and installed-driver checks; not an assertion about every possible tool on the computer

frameViewSdk.documentedCapability: Session-based FPS and per-frame metrics with PID in FPS sample structure
frameViewSdk.blocker: Current token can query service state, but requesting start and stop access returned Win32 error 5; temporary start and restore was therefore not attempted

officialReferences.supports: Upstream PresentMon v1.9.0 command-line options and ETW purpose
ParseArgPrefix accepts slash, single-hyphen and double-hyphen prefixes; installed bundled build help was also checked directly

conclusion: FPS and game-specific network metrics remain unmeasured in the checked environment. These blockers neither certify performance nor demonstrate poor performance. Independently collected TPS and memory/CPU samples must be interpreted separately.
